title: Liverpool agrees to £120m deal for Barcola after PSG breakthrough
dek: Liverpool has reached an outline agreement with Paris Saint-Germain for winger Bradley Barcola at £120 million, comprised of a guaranteed £100 million plus £20 million in performance-based add-ons, per The Guardian. The deal ends months of haggling over PSG's initial £145 million asking price.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Liverpool will pay an overall £120 million for Barcola: £100 million guaranteed plus £20 million in add-ons tied to individual and team success.
bottom_line: Watch for official confirmation from both clubs and the completion of Barcola's medical. The structure of the add-ons and whether Gakpo's departure materializes will clarify how Liverpool intends to balance this investment against its broader squad architecture.
body: Liverpool has closed in on a £120 million deal with Paris Saint-Germain for winger Bradley Barcola, according to The Guardian. The agreement comprises a guaranteed £100 million upfront and £20 million in add-ons contingent on individual and team performance metrics.

Barcola, a France international, has been Liverpool's primary summer transfer target. Negotiations stalled for months over PSG's initial £145 million valuation before both clubs reached a compromise on Wednesday night, per The Guardian's reporting.
Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola indicated the club will "attempt to improve other areas," and hinted at a potential exit for winger Cody Gakpo, though no destination has been reported.
The deal remains subject to medical evaluation and paperwork, and the specific performance thresholds that unlock the add-ons have not been disclosed.
